reason: My Monin comes with the rest of the order from the distributor, it's always the same and I never run out. At 23 euros a litre, about double what I pay for a syrup, plus deposit bottles to track and send back, I don't see why I'd add a second supplier for a short cocktail list.
objection: Another supplier and another delivery to manage, deposit bottles to keep and return, and a fermented product that might not taste the same from one batch to the next. If it runs out I can't just add it to the usual order.
would_change_my_mind: If my distributor carried it so it arrives with the rest of the stock, in a one-way bottle, at around 15 euros, I'd take the free sample and maybe try it on one signature drink.
